meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 的某个群组里搭起一个长期存在的 wiki 知识库：建好 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录和初始的 index.md、log.md，写入容器技能和群组 CLAUDE.md 里的 wiki 段落。之后 Claude 会按 ingest、query、lint 三种操作持续维护它。
howto.when: 当你提到 “add wiki”“wiki”“knowledge base” 等关键词时触发；你选定要挂到哪个群组后，它会先读 Karpathy 的 LLM Wiki 原文，再和你确认要建什么。

say.text: 给主群加一个 wiki 知识库
say.note: 它会先读模式原文，再问你要建什么

say.text: 把这些 sources 文件逐个整理进 wiki
say.note: 一次处理一个文件，读完再进下一个

say.text: 给这个 wiki 加一个每周的 lint 检查
say.note: 用 schedule_task 安排定期检查

howto.what_en: Sets up a persistent wiki knowledge base in a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ dirs plus starting index.md and log.md, writes a container skill and group CLAUDE.md section so Claude maintains it via ingest, query, and lint.
howto.when_en: Triggers on phrases like "add wiki", "wiki", or "knowledge base". After you pick which group gets the wiki, it reads Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern and confirms the design with you.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to my main group
say_en.note: It reads the pattern, then asks what to build

say_en.text: Ingest these source files into the wiki one by one
say_en.note: Finishes each file before starting the next

say_en.text: Set up a weekly lint check for the wiki
say_en.note: Schedules the lint task via schedule_task
